title: Approved business continuity policy and program charter
description: Versioned policy naming scope (all customer-facing services and supporting functions), accountable executive, review cadence, approval record and change history.
format: Markdown policy in a governed repository with approval record

title: Business impact analysis register
description: Per-function record of consequence over time, maximum tolerable period of disruption, minimum service level, dependencies (people, systems, providers, AI models) and derived recovery objectives, reviewed at least annually and on material change.

title: Continuity plan set and out-of-band copy attestation
description: Plans and runbooks per disruption scenario (loss of people, technology, facility, provider) with evidence that a current copy is reachable when the primary cloud account and identity provider are unavailable.
notes: The out-of-band reachability check could be automated by comparing digests of the governed copy and the offline copy.

title: Exercise and test reports with remediation tracking
description: Dated report for each tabletop, functional or full exercise: scenario, participants (including customer or provider participants), objectives, observed timings, findings and linked remediation items with closure evidence.

title: Key-person dependency register and portability test result
description: Register of capabilities, credentials and decisions that depend on one individual, with named alternates and the result of an exercise in which an alternate or qualified third party performed the capability from documentation alone.

title: Emergency credential custody record
description: Inventory of root, registrar, signing, cloud-organization and break-glass credentials showing custody arrangement (sealed, split or dual control), holders and last verification that the arrangement still works.

title: AI provider dependency and fallback test record
description: Inventory of engineering, operational and runtime functions that call external AI models, with the provider, model version, the defined non-AI or alternate-model fallback and the dated result of operating with the provider disabled.

title: Alternate grant and payment processing drill record
description: Evidence that a sponsor completed an urgent grant through its own bank channel while the platform was unavailable, that the OutOfBandPaymentRecorded reconciliation cancelled the queued instruction, and that no duplicate payment occurred.

title: Critical subprocessor continuity assessments
description: Per critical subprocessor: assurance report type and period, bridge letter where needed, reviewed continuity commitments, concentration and substitution analysis, and exit plan.

title: Customer exit package verification
description: Signed exit manifest with SHA-256 digests, record counts and trial balances that the customer can independently verify, generated in a rehearsal at least annually.
signing: Detached signature over manifest (mechanism not yet chosen)

title: Workforce disruption readiness check
description: Record that every operational role can be performed remotely with managed devices, that no function depends on a single physical site, and that the minimum staffing table per function is current.
